title: Loan-Office
summary: LO'AN-OFFICE, noun In America, a public office in which loans of money are negotiated for the public, or in which the accounts of loans are kept and the interest paid to the lenders.

inlines.v: LO'AN-OFFICE, noun In America, a public office in which loans of money are negotiated for the public, or in which the accounts of loans are kept and the interest paid to the lenders.
